name: Chief Surveyor Vane
excerpt: Chief Surveyor Vane is the nominal head of the Cartographic Division.
notes:
- Chief Surveyor Vane is an elderly man.
- He is the nominal head of the Cartographic Division.
- Vane has largely delegated operational responsibility to his deputy, Harwick Ossel.
- He comes to the office three mornings a week and leaves before midday.
- He has the authority to grant explicit authorization for third-party access to the Division's archive.
